text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My schedule's been a little hectic<n>lately... Maybe I
replaced a few too<n>many meals with Toughness
bars.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But they're so convenient and<n>delicious... It's going
to be a struggle<n>to go without them for a while!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Maybe it'll be okay if I just go<n>with a different
flavor? Like, I could<n>go for shrimp instead of
chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, I've got to deal with all these<n>pimples first! Ugh,
there's no hiding<n>these things!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin seems to be quite worried<n>about the
condition of her skin.
